req.title: Redirect-to rejects invalid status code
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 400 when /redirect-to receives a status_code outside the 300-399 range.

doc.reasoning: The redirect_to handler in httpbin/core.py only sets a custom status_code when `status_code >= 300 and status_code < 400`. Outside that range it silently falls back to 302. However, R-HTTPBIN-026 states the system SHALL respond with HTTP 400 for out-of-range status codes. Reading the actual source carefully: the code does NOT return 400 — it silently ignores the invalid code and returns 302. The requirement says it SHOULD return 400, but the implementation does not. Our tests must faithfully test the REQUIREMENT (expected 400 on invalid input) so they will kill mutants that change the boundary comparisons (>= 300, < 400). We cover: EP positive (valid 301 in range), NEG (status_code=200, out of range below 300), BVA at exact boundaries (299, 300, 399, 400), and DT for multiple out-of-range values. Each test asserts exact status codes to catch comparison-operator mutations.

tests.name: test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_in_range
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
expected: Location header is set to http://example.com
trace: R-HTTPBIN-026: valid 3xx code accepted; catches EP partition for in-range values and comparison-mutation on >= 300
tests.executable:
from httpbin.core import app
client = app.test_client()

def test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_in_range():
    r = client.get('/redirect-to?url=http://example.com&status_code=301', follow_redirects=False)
    assert r.status_code == 301
    assert r.headers.get('Location') == 'http://example.com'

test_redirect_to_valid_status_code_in_range()

tests.name: test_redirect_to_decision_table_no_status_code_defaults_302
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: GET /redirect-to?url=http://example.com with no status_code param, follow_redirects=False
expected: Response status code is exactly 302 (default when no status_code given)
Location header is set to http://example.com
trace: R-HTTPBIN-026: DT row where status_code absent; default 302 must be preserved; catches mutation that changes default status
tests.executable:

client = app.test_client()
